parameter.name: Target Torque
parameter.desc: Target Torque (read; Ascent: FFF8C762 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity as on the FA20DIT, where: FFF8AECA: target torque after the max-torque caps and shaping (0x0BD404 via 0x0BA868); axis of Target Boost and Wastegate Duty Initial/Maximum. Nm = x/80 - 200 (0x116A0C float constants). Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2B0/0x2B1 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Throttle Torque Request
parameter.desc: Throttle Torque Request (read; Ascent: FFF8C772 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity as on the FA20DIT, where: FFF8AEDA: throttle-side torque request after the rev/boost torque limits (0x0BD62C), input of the throttle model 0x0C3E34 (AF98 = AF62 + AEDA - 16000). Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2B2/0x2B3 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Base Timing
parameter.desc: Base Timing (read; Ascent: FFF8BD78 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity as on the FA20DIT, where: FFF8A645 (s8, MOV.B): selected Base Timing table, rate-limited, plus two corrections (0x0C2C08); 0.5 degree units. Feeds A76A -> A76D -> A74B -> fired timing FFF8A744. Logging patch: spare SSM index slot 0x2B4 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Feedback Knock Correction
parameter.desc: Feedback Knock Correction (read; Ascent: FFF8BF03 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity as on the FA20DIT, where: FFF8A79A (s8 <= 0): FBKC integrator (0x0E2BE4); 0x0D9E40 adds x*180>>8 to the 0.5 degree timing sum, so one count = 0.3516 degree. Logging patch: spare SSM index slot 0x2B5 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Fine Learning Knock Correction
parameter.desc: Fine Learning Knock Correction (read; Ascent: FFF8BF19 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity as on the FA20DIT, where: FFF8A7A7 (s8): applied FLKC cell value (0x0E73CC), same 0.3516 degree count as FBKC (0x0D9088: x 0x5A / 128). Index 0x199 (J23) carries a coarser copy (x*45>>6 + 90). Logging patch: spare SSM index slot 0x2B6 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Knock Correction Advance
parameter.desc: Knock Correction Advance (read; Ascent: FFF8BEF6 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity as on the FA20DIT, where: FFF8A791 (u8, MOVU.B): KCA = KCA max x DAM curve (0x0E1FD8); same count as FBKC (0x0DB3D4 x 180 >> 8). Logging patch: spare SSM index slot 0x2B7 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Total Knock Correction
parameter.desc: Total Knock Correction (read; Ascent: FFF8BEDD on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity as on the FA20DIT, where: FFF8A77B (s8) = clamp(FBKC A79A + KCA A791 + FLKC A7A7, -128..127), 0 while FFF886AB bit 5 (0x0DFA88). Logging patch: spare SSM index slot 0x2B8 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Combustion Mode
parameter.desc: Combustion Mode (read; Ascent: FFF8BFD8 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity as on the FA20DIT, where: FFF8A85C (u8): 0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 after start (0x109B4C); 2 = stratified catalyst heating, 3 = second phase, 4 = normal running (roles inferred, Phase 7 / my research notes). Logging patch: spare SSM index slot 0x2B9 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Fuel Rail Pressure
parameter.desc: Fuel Rail Pressure (read; Ascent: FFF89768 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity as on the FA20DIT, where: FFF88884 (u16): filtered rail pressure used by the HPFP controller (0x164DB0 actual vs target) and OBD PID 0x23 (2015/2016); 1639.34 counts per MPa (injector-table axes). In 2017/2018 PID 0x23 reads a different variable; the value here is the HPFP controller input in every image. Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2BA/0x2BB re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Target Fuel Rail Pressure
parameter.desc: Target Fuel Rail Pressure (read; Ascent: FFF8D48E on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity as on the FA20DIT, where: FFF8B9A0 (u16): HPFP target (0x165180: table byte x 150), same unit as the actual. Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2BC/0x2BD re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Target Boost
parameter.desc: Target Boost (read; FFF8ACC4 (u16): final boost target of the electronic-wastegate control (Target Boost (Electronic Wastegate) x the IAT and rpm/baro multipliers, capped; 0x0C8B4A). Same unit as the measured pressure: kPa abs = (x + 3404)/256 (0x232C9A). Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2BE/0x2BF re-pointed at it.)

parameter.name: Boost Control Pressure
parameter.desc: Boost Control Pressure (read; FFF8A14A (u16): measured manifold pressure the boost control compares with its target (0x0C90B2), from FFF8A008 = MAP - 3404 (0x232C9A). Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2C0/0x2C1 re-pointed at it.)

parameter.name: Closed Loop Target
parameter.desc: Closed Loop Target (read; Ascent: FFF8CC44 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity as on the FA20DIT, where: FFF8B31E (u16): closed-loop target, equivalence ratio x 32768 (0x0FF8C8; OBD helper 0x171C88 reports 2^30/x). AFR uses stoich 14.7 (assumed). J20 is a coarse byte of the earlier stage B312. Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2C6/0x2C7 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: A/F Correction (Closed Loop)
parameter.desc: A/F Correction (Closed Loop) (read; Ascent: FFF8CC10 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity as on the FA20DIT, where: FFF8B2F4 (s16): closed-loop correction (0x0FEC3C), factor B2EA = 32768 + B2F4 (0x0FE7F0), limited to +-11469; 32768 = 100 % (inferred from the factor form). Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2C8/0x2C9 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: A/F Learning (FFF811D6)
parameter.desc: A/F Learning (FFF811D6) (inferred; Ascent: FFF81049 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity as on the FA20DIT, where: FFF811D6 (s8, backup RAM): high byte of the learned value FFF8B2E0 (0x0FC400 -> 0x0FC5B4); feeds the long-term trim chain 0x0FD3E4 -> FFF811D9 -> FFF8A689. one count = 0.39 % (the trim chain multiplies fuel by (A689+128)/256, 0x0D15EC, read; corrected 2026-10-30 from 0.78 %). Logging patch: spare SSM index slot 0x2CA re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Throttle Model Air Requirement
parameter.desc: Throttle Model Air Requirement (inferred; Ascent: FFF8C852 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity as on the FA20DIT, where: FFF8AFA8 (u16): (AF2C - 16000)/(AF64 - 16000) x min(05A118, AF56) x 4 (0x0C37D8), 32768 = 1.0; input of Throttle Required Area 05A148 (meaning as % of full-load air inferred). Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2CB/0x2CC re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Torque Model Throttle Opening
parameter.desc: Torque Model Throttle Opening (inferred; Ascent: FFF8C7B6 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity as on the FA20DIT, where: FFF8AF12 (u16): throttle opening from the Throttle Opening from Target Torque tables (0x0C0010), rate-limited; 65535 = 100 % (inferred from being the input of 059D2C). Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2CD/0x2CE re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Throttle Required Area
parameter.desc: Throttle Required Area (read; Ascent: FFF8C85E on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity as on the FA20DIT, where: FFF8AFB4 (u16): Throttle Required Area 05A148(rpm, AFA8) (0x0C4D84), input of Throttle Opening 05A0BC in 0x0C326C; 21468 = wide open (physical unit not determined). Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2CF/0x2D0 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: ETC Target
parameter.desc: ETC Target (read; Ascent: FFF8C864 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity as on the FA20DIT, where: FFF8AFBA (u16): ETC target after start add, idle floor and fault caps (0x0C4E5C); % = (x - 10)/460.09. Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2D1/0x2D2 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Intake Cam Target
parameter.desc: Intake Cam Target (inferred; Ascent: FFF8D436 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity as on the FA20DIT, where: FFF8B94A (s16): final intake AVCS target of 0x15C250 (clamped +-90 degrees, 364.09 counts per degree), read by 0x15C880. Units read; crank/cam degrees and sign convention not verified (inferred). Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2D3/0x2D4 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Exhaust Cam Target
parameter.desc: Exhaust Cam Target (inferred; Ascent: FFF8D3E8 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity as on the FA20DIT, where: FFF8B90A (s16): final exhaust AVCS target of 0x16032C, read by 0x1608D8. Same unit and caveat as intake. Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2D5/0x2D6 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Injector Pulse Width (C0B0)
parameter.desc: Injector Pulse Width (C0B0) (inferred; Ascent: FFF8DBA6 on LT8H300D (2021), found from the 2021 WRX code (read). The same quantity as on the FA20DIT, where: Low word of FFF8C0B0 (u32): output of the first pulse routine 0x0D2BB8 (latency + quantity x flow comp, x 1.25 = counts of 0.8 us). Logged as the low 16 bits: wraps above 52.4 ms. First injector / first pulse (inferred from the call order). Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2D7/0x2D8 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Wastegate Motor Duty
parameter.desc: Wastegate Motor Duty (read; FFF8A96C (s16): wastegate motor drive (0x0C9B64); positive opens, negative closes. The output stage sets the H-bridge PWM to period x |duty| / 25600 (0x22A2EC), so 25600 = 100 %. Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2D9/0x2DA re-pointed at it.)

parameter.name: Wastegate Position
parameter.desc: Wastegate Position (read; FFF8A960 (u16): wastegate position from its sensor (0x085778); 16384 = closed on the seat, larger = more open. % open taking 32768 as fully open (inferred). Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2DB/0x2DC re-pointed at it.)

parameter.name: Wastegate Position Command
parameter.desc: Wastegate Position Command (read; FFF8AC98 (u16): the position the wastegate motor loop follows (0x0C9520), same unit as Wastegate Position. Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2DD/0x2DE re-pointed at it.)

parameter.name: Boost Error
parameter.desc: Boost Error (read; FFF8ACD2 (s16): boost target minus measured pressure (0x0C90B2); positive = below target. P0234 and P0299 count on it. Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2DF/0x2E0 re-pointed at it.)

parameter.name: Target Boost (Table)
parameter.desc: Target Boost (Table) (read; FFF8ACCC (u16): Target Boost (Electronic Wastegate) table output, by rpm and target torque, before the multipliers and cap (0x0C8B32). Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2E1/0x2E2 re-pointed at it.)

parameter.name: Wastegate Control Mode
parameter.desc: Wastegate Control Mode (read; FFF8ACB3 (u8): 0 open (low rpm), 1 feed-forward only, 2 closed loop, 3 closed, 4 engine not running (inferred), 5 fixed position, 6 sweep (0x0C8998). Logging patch: spare SSM index slot 0x2E3 re-pointed at it.)

parameter.name: Wastegate Position Sensor Voltage
parameter.desc: Wastegate Position Sensor Voltage (read; FFF8A95E (u16): wastegate position sensor input, 65535 = 5 V (fault limits 0.46 V / 4.68 V, P2564 / P2565). Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2E4/0x2E5 re-pointed at it.)

parameter.name: Wastegate Position Feed-Forward
parameter.desc: Wastegate Position Feed-Forward (read; FFF8ACCE (u16): feed-forward position from Wastegate Position Feed-Forward (rpm x boost target), before the boost PI (0x0C8C18). Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2E6/0x2E7 re-pointed at it.)
